cases.contract: Review identity and terminal-enum normalization only. Event type is stripped and case-insensitively matched. The project identifier must be portable and the repository reference lowercase sha256 hex. Both missing terminal_outcome and explicit None mean UNKNOWN; non-null values are converted to stripped uppercase strings and must match the declared enum. Empty/unsupported non-null values fail. Ignore generic status. Return only validated event type, project id and repository reference.

Review the bounded file read on a normal supported filesystem. Return at most limit bytes from a regular file. At the explicit checkpoints, reject symlink/reparse paths and inconsistent path/open-handle metadata. Replacing the path by a DIFFERENT REGULAR FILE after handle close must raise READ_CHANGED; a symlink/reparse replacement must raise LINK_REJECTED, and disappearance may raise UNREADABLE. Error precedence follows these explicit checks. Compare ctime within each API because Windows stat/fstat can differ. No atomic guarantee against every possible filesystem race is required.

Review this pure source-manifest path-list validator. Reject traversal, the listed ASCII Windows device basenames CON/PRN/AUX/NUL/COM1..9/LPT1..9 including extensions, trailing dots/spaces, control characters and the explicit illegal punctuation. Reject duplicate files, file/directory and spelling collisions. In addition, reject every case-insensitive alias of the component .git and every case-insensitive alias of the ROOT filename SOURCE_MANIFEST.json, even if it is the only entry. Valid paths must be sorted. No filesystem or general Unicode normalization guarantee is required.

Review check_evidence and its listed helpers. Input is a complete, correctly sealed Evidence record. project_id and task_id are OPTIONAL filters: None and empty string omit that filter; each nonempty supplied filter must equal the record. Omission is permitted and is not authorization. A current matching baseline, repo_path supplied for freshness, and status=valid are all required for valid=True. The explicit test repo_snapshot provider returns the trusted current digest and is not a real Git implementation. No write/release permission is granted.

Review display-name validation and title construction. Locale is already zh-CN or en and version is already a numeric semantic version. A name must be trimmed, within the declared length bound, free of Cc/Cf/Cs and have at least one Unicode letter or number (punctuation-only is invalid). Chinese names require Han text, including supplementary-plane ideographs such as U+20000; English names must reject that same Han range. The title constructor is called ONLY with names that already passed _release_name; it must check combined codepoint and UTF-8 byte limits, not revalidate names. This is a display contract, not command escaping.

Review assert_current_window. Accept timezone-aware instants in [created_at, expires_at), including equivalent offsets. Reject malformed/missing/naive timestamps, invalid ordering and instants outside the window. The input domain includes year 1 and year 9999 ISO timestamps with nonzero offsets. Every parse or UTC-conversion failure, including out-of-range conversion, must be reported as RoutingError(TIME_WINDOW_INVALID), not a raw exception. No guarantee is required beyond Python datetime precision.
